import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        final long Mod = 1000000007;

        // Fast exponentiation
        long fastPow(long a, long p) {
            long res = 1;
            long base = a % Mod;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    res = (res * base) % Mod;
                }
                base = (base * base) % Mod;
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(fastPow(p, p - 1));
            return;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(fastPow(p, p));
            return;
        }

        boolean[] used = new boolean[(int) p + 1];
        long ans = 1;
        long groups = 0;

        for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
            if (used[(int) x]) continue;
            groups++;
            ans = (ans * p) % Mod;
            long v = x;
            while (!used[(int) ((v * k) % p)]) {
                used[(int) ((v * k) % p)] = true;
                v = (v * k) % p;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
